title: Filipino Beef Kaldereta
description: A classic Filipino beef stew cooked in a rich tomato-based sauce and served with steamed rice.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.amount: 1 pound beef brisket or beef shank

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, beef broth, patis, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
